The '''Hedrett Council''' was a council that acted as the governing body of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The council was made up of 21 elected members: 9 [[Senior Counselor|senior counselors]] and 12 [[junior counselor]]s, and the vote of a senior counselor on any particular matter counted for twice as much as that of a junior counselor. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Senior Counselor [[Karid Blakken]] served as the leader of the council, until he was unexpectedly defeated by the former criminal [[Westa Impeveri]] in an [[Hedrett Senior Counselor election, 33 BBY|election]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].
